content: Supabase RLS for a child table (e.g. holdings) FK'd to profiles.user_id: give holdings its own user_id uuid column (not just a profile_id FK) referencing auth.users(id), and apply the same (select auth.uid()) = user_id policy directly on holdings for select/insert/update/delete - querying through the parent via a subquery works but is slower and unnecessary when the child row can carry its own owner column. Always wrap auth.uid() in a scalar subquery (select auth.uid()) rather than calling it bare, so Postgres hoists it to a single per-query init-plan instead of re-evaluating per row - this is a documented Supabase RLS performance best practice. Also index the user_id column on the child table.
